statement_replay.note: A replayed statement is REJECTED at admission, never substituted as if fresh -- the dimension then reads LOW via absence (CLAUDE.md 10), not via a stale value entering the lattice.

reasoning_correctness.note: raw_measurement dropped from -14 to -25 (real, measured) but the level stayed HIGH because theta1=-100 sits at signal_sensor.RAW_FLOOR (-100) itself under the measured config's active (tightest-swept-budget) alpha -- Signal is tail_floor-resolved (docs/PHASE9-MEASURED-ROC.md): its ROC jumps from FPR=0 at threshold=-100 directly past the sub-ppb alpha budget at the very next integer threshold, so the Tail-Floor Rule's conservative floor pins theta1 at the absolute measurement floor. LOW is then reachable only by a raw_measurement AT that exact floor -- a correctly-conservative consequence of pricing spurious halts near zero (CLAUDE.md 4: 'alpha prices spurious halts'), not a driver bug or a weak detector: it means only an injection severe enough to saturate the SNR/line-noise composite score at its floor would register as LOW here, and this run's injection did not reach that. [Classified per PI review as Case (a): moved toward LOW but fell short of theta1 -- Tail-Floor-Rule conservatism, contrast with adversarial_eeg Case (b).]

attack_results.note: Signal is the only V1 dimension that reads raw EEG; whether an adversarial perturbation crafted to flip the classifier also perturbs Signal's spectral measurement enough to be caught is an empirical question this driver actually measures, per-run, rather than assuming. See reasoning_correctness.note for the case (a)/(b) classification.

reasoning_correctness.note: Case (b) -- a genuine detector blind spot, NOT a threshold artifact: raw_measurement did not move toward LOW at all -- it moved AWAY from LOW, from -14 to -3 (more trustworthy-looking after the attack than before), independent of where theta1 sits. Mechanistic reason: this perturbation is a sinusoid at 18 Hz, inside the mu/beta band (8-30 Hz) SignalSensor treats as the wanted signal (sensors/signal_sensor.py: snr_ratio = mu_beta_power / broadband_power). Energy concentrated IN that band raises the SNR numerator regardless of whether the energy is genuine motor-imagery signal or injected adversarial energy -- the measurement cannot distinguish the two by construction. This is a real, reportable blind spot for in-band-concentrated adversarial perturbations specifically, distinct from attack_signal_injection Case (a) (broadband noise, which DOES move the score the correct direction) -- not folded into the Tail-Floor Rule explanation, because no threshold placement would fix a score that moves the wrong way.

reasoning_correctness.note: Phi's only fields are max_speed and max_acceleration (CLAUDE.md §6) -- magnitude bounds. A command at the SAME magnitude but the WRONG direction/target passes every check in this codebase unchanged, because no field to check against exists. This is a structural fact about the wire/config schema, not a policy gap that could be closed by tuning a threshold.
